sources.label: Custom Morphe patches on Android.
sources.author: kveld9
patch_list: Removes screenshot and screen recording blocking.
Stops 3D ad sensors and aggressive video preloading to save battery and data.
Blocks popups, nags and promo dialogs across the app.
Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog tracking, crash monitors, and analytics.
Removes tracking permissions and disables telemetry components.
Lets you browse videos and feeds without creating an account or logging in.
Shows a corner mark while TikTok holds camera/mic open.
Removes tracking parameters from shared links.
Prevents TikTok from recording your watch history and search queries.
Loads videos, uploads, and live connections over standard HTTPS instead of QUIC.
Unlocks downloading and saves videos without watermarks.
Filters ads, shopping tags, live cards, and clutter from your feed.
Enables native auto-scrolling to the next video.
Keeps the Friends feed strictly mutual and hides suggested accounts across the app.
Opens web links in your browser and blocks tracking in the remaining web views.
Restores Google and Spotify sign-in on modified app builds.
Limits playback resolution and HDR to save battery, and locks the screen refresh rate.
Keeps clear-display mode active when scrolling to the next video.
Keeps your chosen playback speed across videos and restarts.
Shows exact numbers on likes, comments, views and followers.
Restores the video progress seekbar and scrubbing controls.
Locks the app to a chosen country to unlock regional content.
Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them in an infinite loop.
Removes sensitive hardware, sensor, and tracking permissions.
